title: Connection
subtitle: How two people's charts combine: a way to observe dynamics, not to judge them.
footnote: This reading describes how the energies of two charts meet according to the Human Design system. It does not measure compatibility or the worth of a relationship: a bond is far more than a chart, and is made of choices, listening and time.

empty.title: You need two people for a connection
empty.none: Add two charts to see how their energies meet.
empty.one: You have only one saved chart. Add a partner, a relative or a friend to see the connection.

wheel.title: Wheel of the 64 gates for {{a}} and {{b}}

theme.title: Connection theme

bucket.veryDefined: Together you have almost every center defined: the pair has plenty of its own energy and a strong identity as a unit. That is a great resource; it is worth leaving room for what comes from outside.
bucket.defined: Most centers are defined: there is a solid, recognizable base, with a few open spots where you both stay receptive to what surrounds you.
bucket.balanced: Definition and openness balance each other: in some areas you are steady, in others more sensitive to the environment and to change.
bucket.open: Many centers stay open: together you are very sensitive to your surroundings and the people around you, with a great capacity to adapt. Choosing your settings with care can help.

theme.note: The theme is an indicative reading of the system, not a measure of the quality of the bond.

definition.title: The composite
definition.hint: Putting together every gate of both people forms a chart "for two".
definition.label: Composite definition

centers.title: Centers defined together
centers.none: No center is defined in the composite.
centers.note: The dots show who already defines the center (violet A, orange B). "Only together" marks centers that neither of you has defined alone.

dynamics.title: The channels between you
dynamics.hint: Every channel of the composite falls into one of four dynamics, depending on who carries which gates. They are tendencies to observe, not verdicts.
dynamics.none: No channel forms in the composite: your gates meet without completing each other.

electromagnetic.title: Electromagnetic
electromagnetic.short: Two halves looking for each other
electromagnetic.body: Each of you carries just one of the channel's two gates: alone the channel does not exist, together it is complete. Many describe it as attraction or spark, the feeling that the other brings something that was missing. It can be lively and intense: knowing about it helps you give it room without turning it into dependence.

compromise.title: Compromise
compromise.short: One has the channel, the other carries a part
compromise.body: One person has the whole, steady channel; the other carries only one of its gates. A little friction can arise: the one with the whole channel tends to act consistently, the one with a part may feel pulled in that direction. Talking about it openly and recognizing each other's rhythms helps find a balance.

dominance.title: Dominance
dominance.short: A theme that belongs to one of you
dominance.body: Only one person has this channel; the other carries neither of its gates. Whoever lacks it may feel it as very present and sometimes be influenced by it; whoever has it simply lives what comes naturally. It is not a hierarchy: it is an invitation to ask what is mine and what I am absorbing from the other.

companionship.title: Companionship
companionship.body: You both have the whole channel. On that theme you understand each other easily, speak the same language and feel at home. For that very reason the spark of difference may be missing: it is a solid base to build on, more than a tension that sets things in motion.

carrier.compromise: {{owner}} has the whole channel; {{other}} carries only gate {{gate}}.
carrier.dominance: Only {{owner}} has the channel; {{other}} carries neither of its gates.
carrier.companionship: The channel is whole in both {{a}} and {{b}}.
